response.sql:
WITH site_status AS (
  SELECT s.questregistry, s.zoneref, t.healtheval,
         s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0) AS rate
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS t ON s.zoneref = t.zoneregistry
), status_stats AS (
  SELECT healtheval,
         AVG(rate) AS avg_rate,
         COUNT(DISTINCT zoneref) AS distinct_sites
  FROM site_status
  GROUP BY healtheval
), above_average AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(avg_rate) OVER () AS all_status_avg
  FROM status_stats
), selected AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM above_average
  WHERE all_status_avg IS NOT NULL AND avg_rate > all_status_avg
)
SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS avg_rate_of_statuses,
       AVG(distinct_sites) AS avg_distinct_sites,
       AVG(avg_rate - all_status_avg) AS avg_excess_over_all_status_avg
FROM selected;

assumptions.assumption: A status's rate is the average of individual scan file-size-per-minute rates for scans with nonmissing size and duration; zero durations are excluded as undefined.
The all-status average is the unweighted average of the per-status rates, including statuses whose rate is missing; SQL AVG ignores missing rates.
